scene: You emerge onto the windy rooftop transit platform atop the high tower.
picture: A flat side-view of a windswept rooftop transit hub. On the left hangs a spherical glass cable pod. In the centre sits a silver bullet train beside a platform where you stand in your red bomber jacket and roller skates. On the far right is a glowing, serpentine maglev dragon train.
shown: a round glass cable pod swaying gently from an overhead wire on the left
a sleek silver bullet train waiting with open doors in the centre
a winding maglev dragon train humming softly on tracks to the far right
